rules: The UI shows a link only when status is 'verified' for that exact meal and service.
Plain HTTPS links only, exactly as copied from the service. No invented deep links, URL schemes or tracking parameters.
No price, stock, delivery or promotion claims. The prototype does not take orders or payment.
